body:
Attacks the company, including in a transformed body, and returns in later confrontations.

Recorded role and choices

The April 2025 scene shows Concha initiating an attack and later fighting in a gorilla form. Further named appearances occur in September and November, including an assault on Gregory. The visible transformations and attacks are recorded without deriving a complete spell list, assigning a permanent species from the picture or declaring an unverified final fate.

Prominence and evidence

Prominence unrated. The source footprint alone does not establish the importance of this identity. Consequences, institutional or witness role and relationships need a supported assessment.

Recorded presence combines dialogue volume and span. A brief appearance can still have lasting consequences; missing context is left unrated rather than assigned a low importance.

Archive record

The census records 7 posts across 2025-04-26 → 2025-11-29. These dates identify when messages were posted, not automatically when events happened. An encounter label can refer to a form, a collective or more than one scene identity.
